title: Moses — God's Chosen Leader
memory_verse: "The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation." — Exodus 15:2 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn the story of Moses and how God used him to deliver the Israelites from slavery in Egypt.
content: The Israelites, Abraham's descendants, had become slaves in Egypt. They cried out to God for help, and God heard their prayers. He chose a man named Moses to lead His people to freedom.
When Moses was a baby, his mother hid him in a basket in the river to save his life. Pharaoh's daughter found him and raised him as a prince! But God had bigger plans for Moses.

Years later, God spoke to Moses from a burning bush and told him to go back to Egypt to free the Israelites. Moses was afraid, but God promised to be with him. God sent ten plagues on Egypt to show His power.

Finally, Pharaoh let the Israelites go! But then he changed his mind and chased them. The Israelites were trapped at the Red Sea, but God parted the waters so they could walk through on dry ground. God saved His people in an amazing way!
activity: Act out the story of Moses parting the Red Sea. Use blue paper or fabric for the water. Then draw your favorite scene from Moses' life and write the memory verse.
discussion: How did God protect baby Moses?
Why was Moses afraid to talk to Pharaoh?
How does God help us when we are afraid?
